items.title: 'Coalition of the willing' meets in Paris to bolster war support to Ukraine
items.description: Ukrainian drone strikes killed four people and wounded seven in Russia on July 13, most in the Moscow region, as Kyiv upped its strikes in response to Kremlin's barrages. This comes as the 'coalition of the willing', a coalition of Ukraine's allies, gather in Paris. FRANCE 24's Gulliver Cragg tells us more.

items.title: US and Iran trade strikes as ceasefire comes under growing strain
items.description: Iran's IRGC says it attacked sites linked to the US military in Kuwait, Bahrain and Oman after latest US bombardment.

items.title: Ukraine's allies gather in Paris to rally support, pile pressure on Russia
items.description: More than 25 heads of state will join Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky in Paris on Monday for a summit aimed at pushing a ceasefire and countering signs of allied fatigue, a day before Zelensky joins France's Bastille Day military parade.

items.title: 50 years since Entebbe: Operation Thunderbolt - Sponsored Content
items.description: Noam unpacks Operation Thunderbolt, Israel's secret operation to rescue the hostages at Entebbe, and asks whether this story has enduring lessons for us today. The post 50 years since Entebbe: Operation Thunderbolt appeared first on The Times of Israel.

items.title: Poland could cut arms aid to Ukraine as WWII spat continues
items.description: As Poland observes a day of remembrance for the victims of a Ukrainian nationalist military unit, there are increasing signs that it could cut off its neighbor from military aid, even as the war against Russia continues.

items.title: US Senators, Administration Agree To Advance Russia Sanctions Bill; Kyiv Hails Move
items.description: A bipartisan group of US senators said they had reached an agreement with the Trump administration to advance long-delayed legislation aimed at imposing tougher economic penalties on Russia and countries that continue to support Moscow’s war economy.

items.title: New cholera outbreak alert for Sudan’s war-weary communities
items.description: In war-torn Sudan, a deadly new cholera outbreak has already claimed more than 100 lives, heightening serious concerns for vulnerable communities including in besieged El-Obeid, where daily drone attacks have continued to hamper aid access.
